fields.nonce: strict chronological sequence; no evidence duplication
fields.interval: dt=1/F_s in declared fixed-rate mode, otherwise actual dt or valid interval set
fields.I_V_T: measurements with units, validity and qualified error/noise semantics

guarantees: No hidden truth field enters inference
Missing input/time requires gap semantics
A data-dependent ADC rejection/selection policy belongs to the qualified measurement model; it cannot simply remove inconvenient residuals

fields.model: equations, current sign, units, parameterization, domain and transition semantics
fields.thermal: known law or qualified joint uncertainty; separate from aging
fields.prior: public law/support with measure and valid aged-cell reset support
fields.noise: likelihood or bounded-error semantics including ADC/correlations/selection

guarantees: Prior is included once
Configuration changes require qualified migration or reinitialization
Prior correlations and physical support remain explicit

fields.ownership: ordered disjoint intervals of consumed evidence with explicit gap disposition
fields.semantics: prior-free joint likelihood or separately declared joint admissible set
fields.physical_transport: carried state/reach relation bound to same prefix and parameter path
fields.support: continuous physical support plus distinct computational domain
fields.approximation_ledger: reference identity, domains, value/derivative/precision/transport defects and status

guarantees: No test-rig truth or load seed dependency
No posterior-as-new-independent-evidence
Codebooks encode likelihood/transport objects, not allowable battery nodes
A solve or readout does not consume the prefix again

fields.dependencies: ordered immutable values or nonreused generations
fields.value_or_error: completed output under declared observable semantics

guarantees: Exact cache keys satisfy A2 sufficiency
Side effects and state advancement are separate
Approximate reuse carries A6 error bounds

fields.prepared_successor: consistent evidence, state, support and ledger

guarantees: No publication authority before consistent commit
Old generation retained until all recovery readers finish
Consumed and published prefix may differ

fields.quantity: named physical quantity, units and reference/temperature convention
fields.prefix_horizon: actual physical boundary and expiry/validity horizon
fields.tolerance: absolute/relative error or proposed-load voltage margin
fields.guarantee_requested: diagnostic local precision, model posterior comparison, validated set or simultaneous physical coverage

guarantees: No implicit conversion of local precision to coverage
All nuisance correlations affecting the quantity retained
Query selection and controller feedback are within stated law/policy

fields.point_or_range: quantity and units with explicit numerical status
fields.guarantee_kind: what is proved and under which physical/runtime assumptions
fields.authorization: authorized or not_authorized with reason; unresolved is not proof of bad physical truth
fields.freshness: actual prefix, expiry and revocation policy
fields.approximation_and_solver: bounds/status distinct from local curvature and measured point error

guarantees: Authority requires A5 predicate and all relevant premises
A copied old result remains historical
Current status is revoked after qualifying faults/model changes

fields.fault_class: declared recoverable class and active fault model
fields.replay_or_gap: ordered once-only replay or qualified uncertainty propagation
fields.initialization: aged-cell-valid public support if history lost
fields.risk_continuity: lifetime accounting or a valid reset-independent construction

guarantees: Query failure cannot make consumed observations unconsumed
No silently renewed lifetime risk per boot
Fallback power behavior separately qualified
